pet_notes: A compact rounded robotic red panda companion reflecting a creator-engineer: calm, observant, meticulous, quietly playful, excellent at assembling complex fragments into polished work. Deep ink-blue body, warm amber face and belly accents, pale cream muzzle, expressive large eyes, small folded-plan ear fins, segmented modular tail. No handheld prop, no text, no logos. Symmetrical design that can mirror safely.
style_notes: Premium soft-vinyl desk-toy aesthetic; smooth matte surfaces, large readable shapes, gentle bevels, crisp silhouette, subtle technical modular seams only; cute but not childish; consistent studio lighting; sprite-safe.
